params.brief: D-078/D-084/D-085 + PORT_M2_SHEETS_SPEC CC-M2-15..24 + LABEL_ATLAS_V2 §2.2/§2.5 (the atlas champion)
params.determinism: no RNG; every grouping is an explicit lexsort; the forward-value probe walks a fixed stride
params.grain: one row per generation-v3 roster candidate

guards.forward_value: |Spearman| vs any outcome > 0.980 is a refusal
guards.holdout: m3_common.check_holdout — a refusal, never a filter

joins.cross_asset: the most recent CLOSED cell of each asset whose last candidate row sits at or before this row's epoch second, own-asset leg stepped back past self (batch4 R76), freshness <= 3 days
joins.forecaster: latest anchor with anchor_sec <= dec_sec; typed-missing (fc_available=0) where there is none
joins.news: NEWS_DISTANCE.tsv on cid; absence = no release within +/-15min

params.population: every FIT + GATE session of SI/HG/NKD; the D-058 pre-exam holdout is EXCLUDED BY THE GUARDED ENUMERATOR (pattern_lib.sessions_fit) and REFUSED by m3_common.check_holdout if it ever reaches the matrix
params.section: M3.1 feature matrix (candidate grain, v3 roster)
params.source: pattern_lib.frame(with_levels=True, with_v3=True) + the four census helpers imported verbatim (batch5._s10_of / batch5._unspent_session / batch5._event_stats / batch4._mins_to_release) — no second definition of anything

targets.primary: y_retg_rank_phase = retg|e30|sess_close, rank-within-PHASE — the atlas champion class, the one rank cell top-ranked for all three assets (ATLAS_V3_REPORT.md); §2.5: the RANK TRANSFORM wins, the ranking OBJECTIVE loses
targets.t1: CC-M2-2.2(b) pairwise preference in Borda form, at the frozen EPISODE_CAUSAL group (primary) and the (asset,phase) CELL (variant)
targets.winner: D-021 walled winner indicator, refusals excluded from both halves (R122)

params.teacher_features_spec: design/TEACHER_FEATURES_V1.md §2 (PROVEN) + §3 (SUPPORTED); §4 FALSIFIED cues are NOT shipped as standalone columns and §6 HYPOTHESIS cues are not shipped at all (TF-H1 is graded DEAD by round 2; TF-H2/TF-H3 have no committed field)
